ZZehnMS prototype
Showcase only: dummy data, nothing is saved. These are static screens that show how ZehnMS looks. Buttons and forms do nothing, except a few that walk you to the next screen. The shop, people and figures are made up.

Screens

13 screens
  • Sign inThe owner or a cashier signs in with an email or login ID.login.html
  • First-run setupTwo steps on first open: the owner account, then the shop details.setup.html
  • DashboardHow today went: sales, money in, who owes, a 7-day chart, low stock.dashboard.html
  • TillThe point of sale: scan bar, the bill, the big total, Cash / Bank / Credit, tendered and change.till.html
  • Till with size pickerThe same till with the Bread size picker open under the scan bar.till.html
  • ReceiptThe paid sale with its thermal receipt, ready to print, then a new sale.receipt.html
  • ProductsProduct list with filters, stock pills and a grouped Bread family (3 sizes).products.html
  • Add productBasics, pricing by amount on cost with a live summary, stock, and the Add category side panel.product-form.html
  • Purchase billA supplier bill from Punjab Flour Mills with lines, totals and what is still owed.purchase.html
  • PartiesCustomers and suppliers with their balances: owes you, you owe, settled.customers.html
  • Customer ledgerOne customer's entries with a running balance and the Receive payment side panel.customer-ledger.html
  • ReportsEvery report in one place, grouped Sales, Stock, Money and Team.reports.html
  • Trial balanceA financial statement where debits equal credits.trial-balance.html
  • SettingsSettings sections, feature switches (some not in this edition) and the licence panel.settings.html

Walkthrough

Start at Sign in, press Sign in to reach the Dashboard, press New sale to reach the Till, then Take cash to see the Receipt. The sidebar moves between the other screens.

Shop: Al-Noor General Store, Lahore (fictional). Phone numbers follow the fake pattern 0300-0000000. Public Sans font under the SIL Open Font License (assets/fonts/OFL-PublicSans.txt). Icons: Bootstrap Icons, MIT licence.
